handback.t:
The Norwegian docs are refreshed and pushed to `master` (commit 5bbd67d). Only four files changed, because nine of the twelve existing `.no.md` files already matched their English source.

**What I checked:** `git diff 3c22fdc HEAD` shows only `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `README.md` and `deploy/aws.md` changed in English since the Norwegian copies were created. The other nine English docs (business ×3, financial ×2, fundraising, hiring, technical ×2) are untouched. I compared heading, table and bullet counts for each against its `.no.md`, and they match exactly. I did not re-translate those nine; doing so would only have produced diff noise.

**Re-translated from the current English:**
- `ARCHITECTURE.no.md`: adds the API request path, the auth/DB/storage/sandbox modules, tenant isolation, persistence, bounded parsing, and the updated known-gaps list. It drops the old "stateless MVP, no auth/DB" claim.
- `README.no.md`: covers the production foundation, the 171-test run vs CI vs not-run breakdown, running with auth + Postgres, the `C2C_*` config table, and the "Before real customer data" list. It includes the new `marketing/` and `developer-portal/` repo-map lines and the Developer portal section.
- `deploy/aws.no.md`: the full feature-to-AWS mapping table, environment variables, first-deploy checklist and prerequisites status.

**New:** `marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md`. Its header says only this plan is translated, and that `marketing/landing/` (outline and calculator spec) and the developer-portal API pages stay in English; references to them point to the English originals.

**Caveats preserved:** pre-product status, synthetic data, third-party penetration test, advokat/legal review of every credit-memo claim, buy-side only scope with seller-side under-billing not built, competitors unverified, no traffic or revenue figures, and "no WorldCC percentages pre-filled". Code blocks, commands, API field names and `C2C_`/`c2k_` identifiers are unchanged.

**One thing to decide:** the English `marketing/seo-and-growth.md` says in two places (the hreflang checklist item and the last risk bullet) that `.no.md` copies of the marketing docs are not produced yet. I translated those lines faithfully and added a header note in the Norwegian file saying it is the first, unreviewed translation. Those two English sentences are now out of date. I left the English alone, since English is the source of truth and I was not asked to edit it.

I touched no `src/`, code or tests, and did not stage the untracked `.claude-flow/` directory.
